versos.grego: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἐφανέρωσεν ἑαυτὸν πάλιν Ἰησοῦς τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Τιβεριάδος· ἐφανέρωσεν δὲ οὕτως.

controles.web: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
controles.kjv: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
controles.livre: Depois disto Jesus se manifestou outra vez aos discípulos, junto ao mar de Tibérias; e manifestou -se assim:

versos.grego: ἦσαν ὁμοῦ Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ Θωμᾶς ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος καὶ Ναθαναὴλ ὁ ἀπὸ Κανᾶ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ οἱ τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ ἄλλοι ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ δύο.

controles.web: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
controles.kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
controles.livre: Estavam juntos Simão Pedro, e Tomé (chamado o Dídimo), e Natanael (o de Caná de Galileia), e os filhos de Zebedeu, e outros dois de seus discípulos.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτοῖς Σίμων Πέτρος Ὑπάγω ἁλιεύειν. λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Ἐρχόμεθα καὶ ἡμεῖς σὺν σοί. ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἐνέβησαν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ νυκτὶ ἐπίασαν οὐδέν.

controles.web: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.”   They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out, and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
controles.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
controles.livre: Disse-lhes Simão Pedro: Vou pescar. Dizem-lhe eles: Também nós vamos contigo. Foram, e subiram logo no barco; e aquela noite nada pescaram.

versos.grego: πρωΐας δὲ ἤδη γινομένης ἔστη Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸν αἰγιαλόν· οὐ μέντοι ᾔδεισαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν.

controles.web: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
controles.kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
controles.livre: E fazendo-se já manhã, Jesus se pôs na praia; porém os discípulos não sabiam que era Jesus.

versos.grego: λέγει οὖν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς Παιδία, μή τι προσφάγιον ἔχετε; ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ Οὔ.

controles.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?”    They answered him, “No.”
controles.kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
controles.livre: Então Jesus lhes disse: Filhinhos, tendes algo para comer? Responderam-lhe: Não.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Βάλετε εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ μέρη τοῦ πλοίου τὸ δίκτυον, καὶ εὑρήσετε. ἔβαλον οὖν, καὶ οὐκέτι αὐτὸ ἑλκύσαι ἴσχυον ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους τῶν ἰχθύων.

controles.web: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.”   They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Lançai a rede do lado direito do barco, e achareis. Lançaram-na pois, e já não a podiam tirar pela multidão dos peixes.

versos.grego: λέγει οὖν ὁ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ Πέτρῳ Ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν. Σίμων οὖν Πέτρος, ἀκούσας ὅτι ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν, τὸν ἐπενδύτην διεζώσατο, ἦν γὰρ γυμνός, καὶ ἔβαλεν ἑαυτὸν εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν·

controles.web: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!”   So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around him (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
controles.kjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
controles.livre: Disse pois aquele discípulo, a quem Jesus amava, a Pedro: É o Senhor! Ouvindo pois Simão Pedro que era o Senhor, vestiu-se com a roupa, (porque estava nu), e lançou-se ao mar.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἄλλοι μαθηταὶ τῷ πλοιαρίῳ ἦλθον, οὐ γὰρ ἦσαν μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἀλλὰ ὡς ἀπὸ πηχῶν διακοσίων, σύροντες τὸ δίκτυον τῶν ἰχθύων.

controles.web: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
controles.kjv: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
controles.livre: E os outros discípulos vieram com o barquinho (porque não estavam longe da terra, mas sim a cerca de duzentos côvados) trazendo a rede de peixes.

versos.grego: ὡς οὖν ἀπέβησαν εἰς τὴν γῆν, βλέπουσιν ἀνθρακιὰν κειμένην καὶ ὀψάριον ἐπικείμενον καὶ ἄρτον.

controles.web: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.
controles.kjv: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
controles.livre: Quando pois desceram à terra, viram já as brasas postas, e um peixe posto nelas, e mais pão.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐνέγκατε ἀπὸ τῶν ὀψαρίων ὧν ἐπιάσατε νῦν.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
controles.livre: Disse-lhes Jesus: Trazei dos peixes que pescastes agora.

versos.grego: ἀνέβη Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ εἵλκυσεν τὸ δίκτυον εἰς τὴν γῆν μεστὸν ἰχθύων μεγάλων ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα τριῶν· καὶ τοσούτων ὄντων οὐκ ἐσχίσθη τὸ δίκτυον.

controles.web: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fish, one hundred fifty-three; and even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
controles.kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
controles.livre: Simão Pedro subiu, e puxou a rede para a terra, cheia de cento e cinquenta e três grandes peixes; e sendo tantos, a rede não se rompeu.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Δεῦτε ἀριστήσατε. οὐδεὶς ἐτόλμα τῶν μαθητῶν ἐξετάσαι αὐτόν Σὺ τίς εἶ; εἰδότες ὅτι ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast.”   None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
controles.livre: Disse-lhes Jesus: Vinde, jantai. E nenhum dos discípulos ousava lhe perguntar: Tu quem és? sabendo que era o Senhor.

versos.grego: ἔρχεται Ἰησοῦς καὶ λαμβάνει τὸν ἄρτον καὶ δίδωσιν αὐτοῖς, καὶ τὸ ὀψάριον ὁμοίως.

controles.web: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
controles.kjv: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
controles.livre: Então Jesus veio, e tomou o pão, e deu-o a eles; e da mesma maneira o peixe.

versos.grego: τοῦτο ἤδη τρίτον ἐφανερώθη Ἰησοῦς τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἐγερθεὶς ἐκ νεκρῶν.

controles.web: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples, after he had risen from the dead.
controles.kjv: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
controles.livre: E esta era já a terceira vez que Jesus se manifestou a seus discípulos, depois de haver ressuscitado dos mortos.

versos.grego: Ὅτε οὖν ἠρίστησαν, λέγει τῷ Σίμωνι Πέτρῳ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Σίμων Ἰωάνου, ἀγαπᾷς με πλέον τούτων; λέγει αὐτῷ Ναί, Κύριε, σὺ οἶδας ὅτι φιλῶ σε. λέγει αὐτῷ Βόσκε τὰ ἀρνία μου.

controles.web: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?”   He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”   He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
controles.kjv: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
controles.livre: Havendo eles pois já jantado, disse Jesus a Simão Pedro: Simão filho de João,  tu me amas mais do que estes outros ? Disse-lhes ele: Sim, Senhor, tu sabes que te amo. Disse-lhe: Alimenta meus cordeiros.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ πάλιν δεύτερον Σίμων Ἰωάνου, ἀγαπᾷς με; λέγει αὐτῷ Ναί, Κύριε, σὺ οἶδας ὅτι φιλῶ σε. λέγει αὐτῷ Ποίμαινε τὰ προβάτιά μου.

controles.web: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?”   He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”   He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
controles.kjv: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
controles.livre: Voltou a lhe a dizer a segunda vez: Simão, filho de João, tu me amas? Disse-lhe: Sim, Senhor, tu sabes que te amo. Disse-lhe: Apascenta minhas ovelhas.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ τὸ τρίτον Σίμων Ἰωάνου, φιλεῖς με; ἐλυπήθη ὁ Πέτρος ὅτι εἶπεν αὐτῷ τὸ τρίτον Φιλεῖς με; καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Κύριε, πάντα σὺ οἶδας, σὺ γινώσκεις ὅτι φιλῶ σε. λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς Βόσκε τὰ προβάτιά μου.

controles.web: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?”   Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.”   Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
controles.kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe a terceira vez: Simão, filho de João, tu me amas? Entristeceu-se Pedro de que já pela terceira vez lhe dissesse: Tu me amas? E disse-lhe: Senhor, tu sabes todas as coisas, tu sabes que eu te amo. Disse-lhe Jesus: Alimenta minhas ovelhas.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, ὅτε ἦς νεώτερος, ἐζώννυες σεαυτὸν καὶ περιεπάτεις ὅπου ἤθελες· ὅταν δὲ γηράσῃς, ἐκτενεῖς τὰς χεῖράς σου, καὶ ἄλλος ζώσει σε καὶ οἴσει ὅπου οὐ θέλεις.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself, and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you, and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
controles.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
controles.livre: Em verdade, em verdade te digo, que quando eras mais jovem, tu mesmo te vestias, e andava por onde querias; mas quando fores já velho, estenderás tuas mãos, e outro te vestirá, e te levará para onde tu não queres.

versos.grego: τοῦτο δὲ εἶπεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ δοξάσει τὸν Θεόν. καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν λέγει αὐτῷ Ἀκολούθει μοι.

controles.web: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
controles.kjv: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
controles.livre: E disse isto, fazendo entender que Pedro glorificaria a Deus com sua morte. E tendo dito isto, Jesus lhe disse: Segue-me.

versos.grego: ἐπιστραφεὶς ὁ Πέτρος βλέπει τὸν μαθητὴν ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀκολουθοῦντα, ὃς καὶ ἀνέπεσεν ἐν τῷ δείπνῳ ἐπὶ τὸ στῆθος αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Κύριε, τίς ἐστιν ὁ παραδιδούς σε;

controles.web: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus sincerely loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ breast at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
controles.kjv: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
controles.livre: E virando-se Pedro, viu que o seguia aquele discípulo a quem Jesus amava, o que também na ceia se recostara a seu peito, e dissera: Senhor, quem é o que te trairá?

versos.grego: τοῦτον οὖν ἰδὼν ὁ Πέτρος λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ Κύριε, οὗτος δὲ τί;

controles.web: Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
controles.kjv: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
controles.livre: Vendo Pedro a este, disse a Jesus: Senhor, e este, que lhe acontecerá ?

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐὰν αὐτὸν θέλω μένειν ἕως ἔρχομαι, τί πρὸς σέ; σύ μοι ἀκολούθει.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Jesus: Se eu quero que ele fique até que eu venha, que te importa? Segue-me tu.

versos.grego: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν οὗτος ὁ λόγος εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὅτι ὁ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος οὐκ ἀποθνήσκει· οὐκ εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι οὐκ ἀποθνήσκει, ἀλλ’ Ἐὰν αὐτὸν θέλω μένειν ἕως ἔρχομαι, τί πρὸς σέ;

controles.web: This saying therefore went out among the brothers, that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
controles.kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
controles.livre: Saiu, pois, esta conversa entre os irmãos, que aquele discípulo não morreria. Contudo Jesus não lhe disse que não morreria, mas sim: Se eu quero que ele fique até que eu venha, que te importa?

versos.grego: Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μαθητὴς ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ τούτων καὶ ὁ γράψας ταῦτα, καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀληθὴς αὐτοῦ ἡ μαρτυρία ἐστίν.

controles.web: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
controles.kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
controles.livre: Este é o discípulo que testemunha destas coisas, e estas coisas escreveu; e sabemos que seu testemunho é verdadeiro.

versos.grego: Ἔστιν δὲ καὶ ἄλλα πολλὰ ἃ ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ἅτινα ἐὰν γράφηται καθ’ ἕν, οὐδ’ αὐτὸν οἶμαι τὸν κόσμον χωρήσειν τὰ γραφόμενα βιβλία.

controles.web: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
controles.kjv: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
controles.livre: Ainda há, porém, muitas outras coisas que Jesus fez, que se sobre cada uma delas se escrevessem, penso que nem mesmo o mundo poderia caber os livros escritos. Amém.
